# Vendored frontend assets

External assets are served locally so the application does not depend on a CDN.

| File | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | 2.0.11 | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/htmx.org/v/2.0.11> | 0BSD (`htmx.LICENSE`) |
| `alpine-csp.min.js` | 3.17.5 | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@alpinejs/csp/v/3.17.5> | MIT (`alpine.LICENSE`) |

Update the file and this table together. Do not load these assets from a remote
URL in templates.
